stem: Flower quality varies by aisle even though room-average temperature, RH and PPFD meet target. What is the strongest next step?
choices: Map light, temperature, humidity and airflow by position and compare with flower outcomes
Change fertilizer for the entire room
Use the room averages as proof the variation cannot be environmental
Remove all lower flowers before measuring
rationale: Room averages can conceal spatial gradients. Uniformity assessment requires position-specific environmental and crop measurements.
